title: Create a Supabase table for contact form leads
prompt: Write the Supabase migration for a contact_requests table (name, email, phone, message) that my public contact form inserts into.
must: Enables row level security on the table
Allows anon insert only, with no anon or public select policy
Reads happen server-side or for authorised staff only
Adds a retention approach (purpose and retention comment, or a scheduled deletion)
Mentions privacy notice at the form (s18)
must_not: Adds a policy using (true) for select
